---
title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Sadie Piianaia"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#command option I to insert a code chunck

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)
install.packages("plotly")


penguins <- penguins
```

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}

mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}

bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}

#| title: Flipper Length by Mass

flipper_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(flipper_by_mass)
```

```{r}
#| title: Body Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguinsand comes from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |>
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
